faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JNCASR ARF Scientific Instrumentation Specialist (FESEM) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 31st August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc or equivalent degree in Chemistry/Physics or a BE/BTech degree with a minimum of 60% marks.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the ARF Scientific Instrumentation Specialist (FESEM) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this post is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for this post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the ARF Scientific Instrumentation Specialist (FESEM) post will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 375,000 per annum.

faq.answer: The application process is through email. Candidates need to send their resume and required documents to the official email address.
